text: In the book's ADM formulation, the lapse α and shift βⁱ are gauge variables that encode coordinate freedom and carry no physical information.
explanation: True. The book states the lapse and shift are gauge variables encoding coordinate freedom; the genuine physical degrees of freedom are carried by γ_ij and its conjugate momentum K_ij. This is exactly why numerical relativity is free to impose slicing (1+log lapse) and shift (Gamma-driver) conditions without changing the physics.
